incompatibleRuntime.title: This system is not supported by the bundled backend
incompatibleRuntime.description: AionUi opened, but the local AionCore backend cannot run on this Linux version. Please upgrade to a supported Linux distribution and restart AionUi.

incompleteInstallation.title: AionUi installation is incomplete
incompleteInstallation.description: This installation is missing required local resources, so AionCore cannot start. Please download and reinstall the latest AionUi. If the issue returns after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined AionCore.
incompleteInstallation.runtimeComponentDescription: This installation is missing required bundled runtime components, so {{resource}} cannot start. Reinstall the latest AionUi package. If it still happens after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined AionUi components.

packageArchitectureMismatch.title: AionUi package architecture mismatch
packageArchitectureMismatch.description: This AionUi package is for {{packageArch}}, but this Mac is {{deviceArch}}. You may have downloaded the wrong package. Please download and install the {{expectedArch}} package.

dataMigration.title: Local data migration failed
dataMigration.description: AionUi opened, but AionCore stopped while initializing local data. Reinstalling AionUi may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database migration can be inspected.

databaseNewerThanApp.title: A newer version of AionUi is required
databaseNewerThanApp.description: Your local data was created by a newer version of AionUi, and this version can't open it. Update AionUi to the latest version to continue — your data is intact, and no reinstall or data reset is needed.
databaseNewerThanApp.descriptionWithVersion: Your local data was created by a version of AionUi newer than the one installed now (v{{currentVersion}}), so this version can't open it. Update AionUi to the latest version to continue — your data is intact, and no reinstall or data reset is needed.

localDataRepair.title: Local data repair failed
localDataRepair.description: AionUi opened, but AionCore stopped while preparing local startup data such as assistant or agent records. Reinstalling AionUi may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database can be inspected.

startupDirectory.title: Startup directory is unavailable
startupDirectory.description: AionUi opened, but AionCore could not start because the configured work or log directory is missing, unavailable, or blocked by permissions. Check that the configured directories exist and are writable, then restart AionUi.

recoverableDatabaseCorruption.title: Local data is corrupted
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.description: AionUi detected that the local database is corrupted and cannot continue startup. After confirmation, AionUi will back up the old database and create a new local database to continue startup. Past conversations will no longer be shown, and the old database will be kept as a backup file.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.confirmRebuild: Back up old DB and rebuild new DB
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.diagnosticsHint: Sending diagnostics will not modify the local database.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.rebuildFailed: Failed to back up old DB and rebuild new DB

confirmDialog.title: Rebuild the database?
confirmDialog.content: This will back up the currently corrupted database and create a brand-new empty one. Past conversations will no longer be shown (the old database is kept as a backup file). Continue?

transientConcurrentStartup.title: AionUi is starting up
transientConcurrentStartup.description: Another AionUi startup was still using the local data when this window opened. This is temporary and your data is safe — no reinstall is needed. Please wait a moment and try again, or restart AionUi.
transientConcurrentStartup.diagnosticsHint: If this keeps happening, you can send a diagnostics report.

pendingSlow.title: Starting up
pendingSlow.description: AionCore is starting up, please wait. If it doesn't respond after a while, you can quit and reopen the app.

exited.title: Startup didn't complete
exited.description: AionCore couldn't finish starting and has exited. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, please send diagnostics.
exited.diagnosticsReportFailed: Failed to send diagnostics, please retry

portReportTimeout.title: Startup timed out
portReportTimeout.description: AionCore didn't finish starting within the expected time. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, please send diagnostics.
portReportTimeout.diagnosticsReportFailed: Failed to send diagnostics, please retry

startupFailed.title: Startup failed
startupFailed.description: AionCore failed to start. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, please send diagnostics.
startupFailed.diagnosticsReportFailed: Failed to send diagnostics, please retry

kyrn.startingHint: Connecting to the local mu kernel and reading the model and judge configuration.

hiveView.title: Hive
hiveView.graphHint: Arrows show confirmed deliveries. Select a bee to inspect.
hiveView.contextHint: Recorded messages and completed tool output, not the full model prompt. Tool output appears after completion.
hiveView.missingFocus: Assignment was not recorded for this run.
hiveView.selectBee: Select a bee to inspect its activity.
hiveView.waitingRun: Waiting for this Hive’s recorded events.
hiveView.beeMissing: This bee is not in the recorded snapshot.

judgeView.title: Judgments and their effect
judgeView.description: See what the judge evaluated and what actually happened. Suggestions and confirmed actions are kept separate.
judgeView.empty: No judgments recorded in this session yet.
judgeView.question: Question
judgeView.batchFailures: Without an answer, default strategy used: {{count}}.
judgeView.sentHints: Hints sent to the main model
judgeView.unlinkedHint: Recorded without turn correlation. It is shown on its own and is not merged with nearby records.

actions.toRuntime: Judgment handed to the execution layer; this is not proof that the operation completed.
actions.observeOnly: Shadow mode: recorded for comparison, without changing execution based on this judgment.
actions.useDefault: Fell back to this decision point’s default strategy. A fallback is not permission to proceed: risk checks and Hive gates default to the cautious side.
actions.lateIgnored: The turn had already started; this late judgment did not change it.
actions.waitEnded: The wait or task ended without a recorded final judgment.
actions.recordedOnly: A record is available, but no execution effect was confirmed.
actions.mainGiven: The recorded adjustment or hints below were applied to the main model.
actions.allowPublish: Allowed for publication. Check the shared board for what was actually published.
actions.denyPublish: Not permitted to publish this candidate.
actions.allowDelivery: Allowed for delivery, but no receipt is recorded yet.
actions.denyDelivery: Not permitted to deliver this finding to this bee.
actions.delivered: A receipt confirms that this finding reached the receiving bee.

questions.preflight: How should this request be handled?
questions.interjection: Is this interruption a correction, follow-up or side question?
questions.admission: Which tool-output chunks should enter context?
questions.forget: Is the full old tool output still needed?
questions.compaction: Which old results can be pruned?
questions.skills: Which skills are relevant to this task?
questions.locate: Which files are most likely relevant?
questions.routing: Which role and thinking level suit each subtask?
questions.publish: Is this finding worth sharing with other bees?
questions.deliver: Does this finding help the receiving bee?
questions.browser: What should the browser do next?
questions.capture: Is this a lasting correction or preference?
questions.risk: Does this action require user confirmation?
questions.drift: Is the work still on track?
questions.completion: Does this change still need verification?
questions.notify: When should this notification reach the model?
questions.cache: Should the session cache stay warm?
questions.rewind: Is this approach a dead end worth rewinding?
questions.outputDrift: Does the output break one of your rules?
questions.taskFrame: Does this message change the task frame?
questions.constraint: Does this call break one of your constraints?
questions.capabilities: Which capabilities does this task need?
questions.diagnostics: When should these diagnostics reach the model?
questions.patch: Does the sub-agent's patch stay within its task?
questions.review: How serious is each review finding?

kyrn.empty: No events recorded in this session yet.
kyrn.contextPending: Waiting for a fresh context measurement
kyrn.noCompaction: No compaction recorded in this session yet.
kyrn.compactionEstimate: Post-compaction tokens are estimated; the next model response refreshes usage.
kyrn.cacheDetail: Session total: {{read}} cached / {{total}} input tokens. Input includes uncached, cache-read and cache-write tokens; output is excluded. Compaction does not reset the totals.

brand.tagline: A coding agent with a judgment kernel

starters.hint: Not sure where to start? Try one of these:

understand.title: Understand this project
understand.desc: Map the structure, entry points and key modules
understand.prompt: Read through this project first, then tell me how it is structured, where the main entry points are and which modules matter most. Point out the three files worth reading first.

fix.title: Find and fix a problem
fix.desc: Start from an error or a symptom and get to the cause
fix.prompt: I ran into a problem: <describe the symptom or paste the error>. Reproduce it and find the root cause first, then make the smallest fix and run the related tests to verify.

plan.title: Plan a change
plan.desc: Get a plan first, edit after you confirm
plan.prompt: I want to build: <describe what you need>. Give me an implementation plan and the files involved first, and start editing only after I confirm.

boardView.title: Plain-language board
boardView.afterTurn: Switches when the agent finishes this step
boardView.unknown: No board in this conversation yet. It comes with mu conversations while the plain-language board is on under Features.
boardView.off: Once it is on, this says in plain words how the work is going, what the agent is doing now, and what needs you.
boardView.cost: For this project only. Each update costs one model call.
boardView.empty: Give the agent a moment; this will say in plain words how it is going.
boardView.briefHelp: The model did not write this one in time; it is a short fixed summary.
boardView.needsYouText: The agent is waiting for your answer in the conversation.
boardView.quoteHint: Click one to quote it in your reply; nothing is sent until you send it.
